name: Rosca martelo
directions: Dumbbell HAMMER curl. One dumbbell per hand held VERTICALLY with neutral thumbs-up grip, palms face each other THROUGHOUT. Elbows stay at sides, start arms long and curl both weights toward shoulders. No wrist rotation, torso still.
